Title: Do not turn on Lamp during Rad Trend Lamp Checks except between 25 and 35s prior to descending node
Description:
When Rad Trends are scheduled, we do so using the previous week's ATS, and we schedule the lamp to come on exactly 30s before the descending node.

Due to uncertainties in the ephemeris of OCO-2, the time will always slip away from that 30s baseline. 5 seconds in either direction is the acceptable envelope for that slippage until we have to consider rescheduling the activity.

Title: Do not execute single_command in Rad Trend Lamp Checks except between 25 and 35s after descending node
Description:
When Rad Trends are scheduled, we do so using the previous week's ATS, and we schedule the single pixel exactly 30s after the descending node.

Due to uncertainties in the ephemeris of OCO-2, the time will always slip away from that 30s baseline. 5 seconds in either direction is the acceptable envelope for that slippage until we have to consider rescheduling the activity.
